title: GitHub: crmne/fastpotify
description: Stars: 1617, Forks: 65 | Spotify, native and fast. One lightweight Rust app for your whole library, local playback, and Spotify Connect on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

ko.title: Rust 기반의 빠르고 가벼운 네이티브 스포티파이 클라이언트, fastpotify
ko.hook: 무거운 일렉트론 기반 앱에서 벗어나, 리소스 소모가 적은 네이티브 Rust 스포티파이 앱을 경험해 보세요.
key_takeaways: Rust로 구현되어 매우 가볍고 빠른 성능 제공
로컬 라이브러리 재생 및 Spotify Connect 완벽 지원

en.title: Fastpotify: A Native and Fast Spotify Client in Rust
en.hook: Ditch heavy Electron apps for this lightweight, high-performance native Spotify client written in Rust.
key_takeaways: Extremely lightweight and fast performance powered by Rust
Full support for local playback and Spotify Connect
Cross-platform support for Linux, macOS, and Windows

zh.title: Fastpotify：基于 Rust 的快速且轻量级原生 Spotify 客户端
zh.hook: 告别沉重的 Electron 应用，体验用 Rust 编写的高性能轻量级 Spotify 客户端。
key_takeaways: 由 Rust 驱动，提供极致轻量与极速性能
完美支持本地播放与 Spotify Connect 功能
全面支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 跨平台
